register.labelZh: DRUM 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: drum somebody out 可以表示某人因犯錯而被迫離開學會、球隊或組織。；drum something into somebody 表示反覆講解某個構思、規則或警告,直至對方牢記。；drum something up 適合描述人們主動爭取支持、吸引顧客或引起他人興趣。；在這些表達中,DRUM 並非指敲鼓,而可以描述反覆教導、強行逐出或積極爭取某事物。
register.summaryEn: Drum somebody out lets you explain that a person was forced to leave a club, team or organisation because of wrongdoing. Drum something into somebody shows that an idea, rule or warning has been repeated until the person remembers it. Drum something up is useful when people actively try to gain support, attract customers or make others interested. In these expressions, DRUM does not mean playing a musical instrument. It can describe repetition, strong removal or an active effort to attract something.
